title: OPERATORS CAST A SOFT SHADOW TO THE LOWER RIGHT
why: Art build step (his pick: Refined Chibi with Gear-heavy raider). The brief asks for a soft cast shadow. Light is from the top left, so the operator ground shadow now sits a little right and down of the feet with a faint second lobe trailing off, instead of a plain ellipse centred under the body. Two cached stamps, no extra path fills.
now: Operators now throw a soft shadow to the lower right.
